purpose: Explicit semantics for chance-based FlatMMO acquisition sources so a listed source is never mistaken for a guaranteed outcome.

rules.name: Pickpocket success and item drops are separate
facts: Pickpocketing NPCs gives random item drops.
An NPC pickpocket attempt has its own success chance.
The item table has separate rarity odds for individual drops.
A successful pickpocket does not imply that a particular non-1/1 item will be received.
The current documented rarity mapping is Very Common 1/1, Common 1/10, Uncommon 1/100, Rare 1/1000, and Very Rare 1/10000.
notes: Do not multiply an item drop chance by a pickpocket success chance unless the current success chance for that player is also known.
When describing a target item, mention that other documented drops may also occur. Do not assume loot entries are mutually exclusive unless that mechanic is explicitly documented.

rules.name: Monster loot tables are probabilistic per item
facts: Monster loot tables list an amount and rarity for each item.
A rarity of 1/1 is shown as Always and is guaranteed for that monster kill.
A rarity with a denominator greater than 1 is chance-based and must not be described as guaranteed.
notes: Different loot-table entries are not assumed to be mutually exclusive.
When discussing a target drop, other documented drops from that monster may be useful context.
